ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (light grey/white) pixel distribution concentrated in radial streaks near the median notch and extreme lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across the majority of both lobes. High-contrast light-grey radial streaks emanate from the median notch region extending toward the trailing edge. Distinct high-intensity white clusters are localized at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior vertex and a vertical bounding-box depth relative to the fluke apex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by multiple jagged peaks and valleys with varying pixel amplitudes, particularly pronounced on the inner-half of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward and lateral convex sweep of the leading edge, transitioning to a complex concave trajectory along the trailing edge toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters located on the peripheral lateral margins and tips of both lobes, consistent with localized surface colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertically-oriented light-colored linear disruptions visible in the central-ventral region, breaking the uniform dark pigmentation map.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss along the trailing edge. Dense clusters of white circular lesions/encrustations on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly concentrated and symmetrical distribution of white circular markers restricted to the extreme outer points of the fluke lobes.
